core_coverage.answer_quote: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage.
core_coverage.reason: Directly explains the supported general attack effect; particular unit exceptions need not be enumerated.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Below 50% health, this passive damage also heals Warwick, with stronger healing below 25% health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both supported health thresholds without choosing the disputed healing multiplier.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick lunges at a target and bites, dealing magic damage based partly on its maximum health and healing from the damage dealt.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the lunge, damage type, partial maximum-health scaling and associated healing.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Holding the bite carries him behind the target and can follow its movement.
core_coverage.reason: Explains held positioning and tracking without claiming exceptionless tracking.

core_coverage.answer_quote: While the bite is active, he is immune to displacement effects such as knockbacks.
core_coverage.reason: States the supported immunity and its active window without extending it to all crowd control.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick senses enemy champions damaged below 50% health by him or allies, follows trails toward them with bonus movement speed that is temporarily lost in champion combat
core_coverage.reason: Explains eligible champion detection, trails, pursuit speed and the combat restriction.

core_coverage.answer_quote: and gains attack speed against low-health targets.
core_coverage.reason: Explicitly explains the low-health attack-speed benefit.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Both bonuses grow stronger against very wounded enemies.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the supported increase without selecting disputed thresholds or multipliers.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Activating Blood Hunt temporarily marks the nearest enemy champion in its area and grants the bonuses against that target regardless of health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains temporary active marking, nearest-target selection, area restriction and health-independent bonuses.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick temporarily reduces the damage he takes.
core_coverage.reason: Explains temporary protection without choosing a disputed duration.

core_coverage.answer_quote: When the effect expires or he recasts it, he howls, fearing nearby enemies and making them flee.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both general triggers, nearby scope and the fear's effect without claiming immediate recast availability or universal loss of protection.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Warwick leaps in a chosen direction, with more movement speed increasing his range
core_coverage.reason: Explains directional input and movement-speed-dependent range.

core_coverage.answer_quote: He stops on the first enemy champion hit and channels to suppress them, unless their spell shield or crowd-control immunity prevents the channel.
core_coverage.reason: Explains first-target collision, suppression channel and protections preventing initiation.

core_coverage.answer_quote: During the channel, he deals magic damage and heals from damage dealt.
core_coverage.reason: Explains channel damage type and healing without asserting guaranteed damage through suppression removal.

core_coverage.answer_quote: he is immune to crowd control during the leap.
core_coverage.reason: Correctly confines the stated immunity to the leap.

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved exact multiplier: Riot says triple healing below 25% health; Wiki says 250%. The draft correctly retains only stronger healing.

Unresolved threshold and multiplier: Riot specifies triple below 25%; Wiki variously specifies enhancement below 20% and doubling below 25%. The draft correctly retains the supported general increase.
Unresolved maximum protection duration: Riot states 2.5 seconds and Wiki states up to 2.75 seconds. The draft correctly avoids an exact duration.

factual_risks: This support check establishes neither human approval nor visual verification; supplied frames remain unverified.
Frozen excerpts do not establish current-patch behavior.
Q tracking exceptions and cooldown-refund reliability remain QA caveats; the qualified tracking wording does not promise universal following.
W's Nexus Obelisk exception, decoy detection and attack-speed timing are advanced qualifications; the draft does not claim unrestricted vision or exhaustive eligibility.
E's R-triggered howl can preserve protection. The draft does not claim that every howl ends damage reduction.

R target protection is evaluated at collision; later spell shields do not block an existing channel. Suppression removal can leave a nondamaging channel, and a specific Singed interaction qualifies channel interruption.
AD scaling supports the broad learning focus, but does not establish an optimal build. Expanding AD to attack damage would optionally improve beginner clarity.
No provenance, confidence or development labels appear in the answer or counterplay text; UNAPPROVED labels remain in metadata.
